Ubicación: Remoto desde España.

¿Qué experiencia y/o conocimientos son necesarios?
• Experiencia previa de 3 años desarrollando con .NET6, SQL/T-SQL y Docker.
• Conocimientos en Next.js
• Nivel de inglés: B2
• Muy valorable experiencia con Azure DevOps

Stack tecnológico: Entity Framework, OpenAPI, Jira, Git, Arquitectura DDD, Programación Guiada por Pruebas TDD, Principios S.O.L.I.D, Principio D.R.Y, calidad en código.

• Teletrabajo 100% desde España.

En CORUS somos muy conscientes de la importancia de respetar la... diversidad. Ninguna persona será excluida de esta convocatoria por razones de raza, color, edad, sexo, estado civil, ideología, opiniones políticas, nacionalidad, religión, orientación sexual y/o cualquier otra condición personal, física o social. jobs_results.title: .NET and React Developer
jobs_results.description:
About us

At Principal33 we strive to make happiness at work a reality. Because it's not just about the money, it's also about the work environment and appreciation. It's about creating the best team setup you can imagine and getting involved in the things you're passionate about. And you can be a part of it, because it's fun to get things done!

We want our employees to innovate and we allow them to do what they are truly passionate about. Based on this conviction, Principal33 aligns its strategy around its vision: to become a leading IT service company and a better working-life balance. With currently around 200 employees from different countries, we are actively shaping the future of work.

We are seeking a Full Stack Developer with expertise in .NET Core and React to contribute to a new web application project in the aviation industry, requiring a solid foundation in software engineering principles and a strong proficiency in both backend and frontend development.

Your primary... responsibilities include:
• Development: Creating web applications using .NET Core for backend services and React for the frontend, ensuring high performance and responsiveness.
• Code Quality: Maintain high standards of code quality through regular reviews and adherence to best practices.
• Technical Specification: Analyze project requirements to define technical specifications and lead the delivery of solutions. Ability to gather and analyze requirements.
• Data Integration: Work with external data sources and APIs to incorporate maintenance scheduling and cost data into the application.
• Performance Optimization: Identify and implement strategies to enhance application scalability and performance.
• Innovation: Address complex technical challenges with innovative solutions, focusing on efficiency, performance and user experience. Investigate new technologies and build POCs.
• Methodologies: Familiarity with software development methodologies (Agile) and tools for version control (e.g., GIT), CI/CD (eg: Azure Pipelines)

What is expected of you:
• At least 3 years of experience in software development
• Proficiency in C#, .NET Core.
• Knowledge in RESTful API development, database technologies (SQL Server, Entity Framework Core), and cloud services integration.
• Implementing Best Practices and Design Patterns (SOLID, Clean Architecture, CQRS, etc)
• Unit testing (xUnit or similar), Integration Testing, E2E Testing and Vitest/jest & React testing for front-end
• Experience with React(>18) & TypeScript
• Experience with CSS frameworks such as Tailwind
• Experience with Figma (design system)
• State Management (react context, zustand or redux toolkit, tanstack query)
• As an international company, proficiency in speaking and writing English is a must (Minimum C1 level).

Nice to have:
• Experience working in start-ups or Greenfield projects
• Experience in developing and deploying applications in cloud environments, preferably Azure.
• Experience with front-end build tools such as vite
• Experience with automation tools such as Playwright
• Experience building Microservices or Modular Monoliths
• Certifications related to .NET, Azure are a plus but not required.

What we offer:

Way of working: hybrid

Hybrid position at our office in the sunny city of Valencia.

Benefits
• Salary transparency, we tell you about our ranges in our first contact, to ensure that we are aligned with your level of experience and expectations.
• Flexible retribution
• Flexible work hours
• Private medical insurance
• Day off on your birthday
• Referral bonus if you bring your contacts
• Gifts for special occasions
• Office that takes care of your well-being and on top of all we are pet friendly, bring your pet to the office!
• Fridge full of snacks at the office, healthy ones and not so healthy as well Leisure area with gaming-room
• International and multicultural environment

Events

Summer party!

(Self)-Development

Continuous training, we will help you improve your technical skills, evolve in the tech community and develop as a professional.

We are an active part of the tech-community. You may have the opportunity to attend and participate in local and international tech-events.

Wanna join

jobs_results.title: .NET senior developer (WPF)
jobs_results.description:
At Oxigent Technologies we are looking for a .Net developer to join an industry leader in the design and development of fire protection equipment to enhance safety and protect lives and facilities through its solutions, located in Barcelona.

Your main mission will be designing and developing Software applications including offline simulators to design compliant installations, configuration utilities, diagnostic tools, continuous monitoring tools, mobile apps and graphical design, mainly targeted at computers running Windows operating systems,

What are you core activities?

Design and development:
• Propose innovative ideas and create the architecture and mock-ups for prototyping new software applications.
• Implement the software components, ensuring high-quality code.
• Integrate third-party libraries effectively.
• Generate and maintain software releases.
• Debug and resolve reported defects.
• Document software features including application requirements, product specifications... and activity/class diagrams.

Project Planning:
• Develop project timelines, breaking down the scope into internal milestones.
• Estimate effort and duration for identified tasks.
• Identify potential risks and propose mitigation strategies.

Leadership & Collaboration:
• Collaborate closely with remote developers to implement software solutions.
• Work with Hardware & Firmware engineers to design the interactions with the different product components.
• Understand product requirements as defined by Engineering and Product managers and contribute innovative ideas.
• Provide support to the test team during the validation process.

Technical Stack required:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.

• Language: English (B2-C1).

• Proven experience more than 5 years as .NET developer using C# language and MVVM patterns (WPF)

What do we offer you?

• Permanent contract.

• Salary according to the experience provided (between 40.000 to 45.000€/gross per year).

• International and multicultural environment.

• Educational vouchers.

• Hybrid working model (3 days in office / 2 days remote).

• Private medical insurance.

• Special discounts on fitness and sport facilities.

• Tax reduction: you will be able to dedicate part of your gross salary to different options such as transport, ticket restaurant, education, kindergarten and health insurance.

• Many more benefits

jobs_results.title: Architect .Net Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are a digitally native technology services company where innovation, design and engineering meet scale. We use some of the latest technologies in the digital and cognitive field to empower organizations in every aspect.

Right now, we are looking for .Net Developers to join our team at Globant!

You will get the chance to:
• Work with professionals who have created some of the most revolutionary solutions in their fields.
• Make an impact. Work in large-scale projects globally.
• Develop your career in our Studios. Each Studio represents deep pockets of expertise on the latest technologies and trends and delivers tailored solutions focused on specific challenges.
• Develop your career within an industry or multiple industries.
• Work in the city you want, and be nourished by cultural exchanges.
• Be empowered to choose your career path: we have more than 600 simultaneous projects, so you can choose where and how to work.
• Be part of an agile pod. Driven by a culture of... self-regulated teamwork, each team -or POD- works directly with our customers with a full maturity path that evolves as they increase speed, quality and autonomy.

What will help you succeed:
• Believe and love what you do.
• Make "No’s" become "What ifs".
• Have imagination and you love innovating.
• Being flexible & goal oriented.
• Being capable of taking a step back to look at a bigger picture.
• Experience with Azure.
• Experience in application’s design using .Net frameworks.
• Solid knowledge using LINQ and Entity Framework (or other ORM).
• Experience in development and integration with RESTful APIs.
• Knowledge in SQL Server, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) or SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
• Experience with ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, Web API with C#.

At Globant we believe that an inclusive culture and a diverse environment makes us stronger. We encourage people to have an inclusive spirit as our global footprint expands. We seek to generate a place of inspiration and growth for everyone. A safe space, based on equity as a value, where everyone's careers can be promoted and developed in the same way. There is no innovation without diversity and there is no improvement without plurality.

Are you ready?

Job Segment: Developer, .NET, SQL, Database, Architecture, Technology, Engineering

jobs_results.title: Programador .NET
jobs_results.description:
Programador/a .NET presencial.

Evenia Hotels es una cadena hotelera con una larga trayectoria. En la actualidad cuenta con 16 establecimientos hoteleros en 4 países y se encuentra en una fase de expansión nacional e internacional. Como resultado a este crecimiento nuestra área de informática también está creciendo por lo que necesitamos incorporar a nuestro equipo de trabajo 2 PROGRAMADORES .NET en nuestras instalaciones de ROQUETAS DE MAR.

La misión principal del puesto de trabajo corresponde con el desarrollo de un nuevo conjunto de programas informáticos así como el mantenimiento del actual PMS.

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador web ASP.NET - Web API Developer / Senior
jobs_results.description:
Ofrecemos puesto de:

- Senior – ASP.NET – Web API Developer – Bizkaia

· Contrato estable tiempo completo / Promoción y crecimiento profesional dentro de la empresa en las diferentes áreas de negocio

· Remuneración competitiva y acorde a la valía del candidato

· Posibilidad de TeleTrabajo

Buscamos:

- Persona con Máster en Ingeniería Informática o titulación STEM equiparable (Matemáticas – Física - …)

- Experiencia de al menos 5 años en ASP.NET – Web API Developer

- Persona con experiencia en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web SPA, experiencia en Metodologías Ágiles y conocimiento de todos los aspectos relacionados con el Desarrollo de Software, Testeo y su proceso de Publicación.

- Disponibilidad inmediata

- Conocimiento medio de inglés (B2) o superior

Requisitos Mínimos
• 5+ años de experiencia demostrable en el framework ASP.NET (ideal 6.0)
• 3+ años de experiencia con APIs REST.
• Programación acorde a principios SOLID especialmente inyección de dependencias
• 3+ años de... experiencia en testing en backend
• 3+ años de experiencia con Entity Framework

o Imprescindible presentar portfolio de trabajos realizados.

· Residente en Vizcaya, zona Durango y/o alrededores

Se valorará positivamente
• Experiencia con arquitecturas de microservicios en la nube
• Experiencia en deployment de backends (Azure, IIS, etc.)
• Familiaridad con lenguajes de FrontEnd como HTML, JavaScript y CSS
• Conocimientos del mundo de la máquina herramienta y la producción

Tareas / Responsabilidades

Nuestros programadores son responsables de todo el ciclo de vida de las aplicaciones que desarrollan:
• Cooperación con “product owner” para requerimientos y “user stories”
• Colaboración con front-end para diseñar comunicación y dependencias
• Diseño arquitectura y desarrollo de APIs REST
• Diseño arquitectura y desarrollo base de datos
• Documentación, testing y troubleshooting de APIs implementadas
